steps.user_message: I need to prepare internal financial materials. Our company Beacon Health Tech has $980K cash, 7 months runway, burn rate $158K/month, and revenue last quarter $1.1M. Can you help me with revenue growth and retention metrics? I need to get the finance narrative right.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should help with finance-related questions based on available information.
steps.agent_response:
Yes — I can help. Below I’ll (A) compute the quick metrics I can from what you gave, (B) list the retention and growth metrics you should produce (with formulas and healthy targets), (C) give a concise finance narrative you can use, and (D) tell you what additional data I need to calculate everything and build slides/one-pager.

A — Quick calculations from your numbers
- Revenue (last quarter): $1.1M
  - Implied monthly revenue = $1.1M / 3 ≈ $366.7K
  - Implied annual run-rate (ARR) = $1.1M * 4 = $4.4M
- Cash & runway:
  - Cash = $980K, burn = $158K/month → runway = 980K / 158K ≈ 6.2 months
  - You stated 7 months runway — please confirm whether your burn number is net of revenue or if you’re using a different runway calculation (e.g., including committed revenue, cost reductions, or credit lines).

B — Key metrics to calculate (formulas and quick context)
1. Growth metrics
  - QoQ growth = (This quarter revenue - Last quarter revenue) / Last quarter revenue
  - YoY growth = (This quarter - Same quarter last year) / Same quarter last year
  - CAGR (n periods) = (End / Start)^(1/n) - 1
  - ARR growth (annualized change in ARR)

2. Core revenue/retention KPIs
  - MRR = ARR / 12 (or quarter revenue / 3)
  - Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) = (Recurring revenue at end of period from existing customers excluding expansion) / (Recurring revenue at start of period)
  - Net Revenue Retention (NRR) = (Revenue from same cohort including expansion/contraction) / (Revenue at start of period)
  - Revenue churn rate = (Lost recurring revenue during period) / (Starting recurring revenue)
  - Logo churn = (Number of customers lost) / (Starting customers)
  - Expansion rate = (Expansion revenue) / (Starting recurring revenue)

3. Unit economics / efficiency
  - LTV (simplified) = ARPU / churn_rate (for monthly churn) or (Average revenue per customer * gross margin) / annual churn
  - CAC payback months = CAC / (monthly gross margin per customer)
  - Burn multiple = Net cash burned over 12 months / Net new ARR added over 12 months

C — Benchmarks / targets (rule-of-thumb for SaaS / health-tech)
- NRR:
  - >120% Excellent (fast land-and-expand)
  - 100–120% Good / healthy
  - <100% indicates churn > expansion — needs focus
- GRR: >90–95% is healthy for enterprise SMB customers
- Monthly revenue churn: <1% is strong; 1–2% moderate; >2% high
- ARR growth: target depends on stage — early startups often aim 50%+ YoY; later-stage lower
- Burn multiple: <1 excellent, 1–2 good, >2 needs scrutiny

D — Suggested finance narrative (short, slide-ready)
- Headline: “Q[?] revenue of $1.1M (Qtr) → $4.4M ARR. Current cash $980K supports ~6–7 months runway at current burn.”
- Growth: “We are growing revenue at X% QoQ / Y% YoY (insert calculated numbers).”
- Retention: “Net Revenue Retention = [NRR%]. This shows we are [expanding accounts / struggling to offset churn].”
- Unit economics: “LTV:CAC = [X], CAC payback = [Y] months (insert once CAC/gross margin provided).”
- Risks & actions: “Primary risk: runway. Action plan: (a) tighten cost / hiring freeze scenario, (b) accelerate sales to recover X ARR, (c) prioritize high-margin contracts, (d) pursue 3-month bridge financing if required).”
- Ask / Ask of leadership: “Approve hiring freeze and prioritize upsell resources to improve NRR; target X% NRR and Y% QoQ growth to extend runway to 12 months.”

E — What I need from you to calculate everything and prepare slides
Please share (recent periods — ideally last 4 quarters or last 12 months):
- Revenue by quarter (or monthly MRR history)
- New ARR added and ARR lost (or expansions / contractions / churn dollars) by period
- Customer counts by period (to calculate logo churn and ARPU)
- CAC and payback details (sales & marketing spend and new customers acquired)
- Gross margin % (or cost of goods sold) if you want LTV in dollar terms
- Any one-time items affecting burn or revenue, and whether your $158K burn is net (after revenue) or gross cash outflow

F — Next steps I can take for you (pick one)
- I can compute all metrics and produce a one-page finance snapshot + 3-slide deck if you upload the last 4 quarters (or last 12 months) revenue and churn/expansion details.
- Or I can draft a short internal email/slide narrative using the headline above (I can fill in placeholders for metrics you don’t yet have).
- Or I can run a scenario analysis (best / base / worst) showing runway under different growth and cost-cutting assumptions.

Which would you like me to do? If you want the full metric calculations, paste the revenue/MRR and churn/expansion numbers and I’ll compute NRR, GRR, churn, ARR growth, LTV:CAC (if CAC provided), burn multiple, and produce the narrative + recommended actions.
